Class WarZoneJSON

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Model.ActionJSON.ActionJSON
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Model.ActionJSON.WarZoneJSON
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class WarZoneJSON extends ActionJSON
This class represents the players' actions in the warZone card in JSON format. The class is designed to be serialized and deserialized using Jackson annotations
